result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and consistent. The only notable visual defect is the restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel being clipped by the right screen edge. Per instructions, horizontally scrollable rows with partially visible last items (including clipped titles) and content cut off by the bottom viewport are treated as features, not defects. No other broken elements (contrast, alignment, missing assets, or layout errors) were observed.
